title: lens.event.v1
description: Append-only event envelope. The event log is the system of record; every projection is rebuilt from it.

event_id.description: Opaque, time-ordered, never reused. Carries no names, locations or case numbers.

seq.description: Log position. Strictly increasing within a cell.

ts.description: Commit time on the core's clock.

agency.description: Owner of the resource the event is about.

resource.description: LRN of the resource, e.g. the camera.

actor.description: Who caused it: an operator id, perception/<model_version>, watchdog, console, eventcore.
